items.title: Henry "Pickle" Jackson Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: He was the one who gave me my inspiration.

ctx.x: You say when you used to hear him and you?

Well, Chiney, he was a wonderful drummer. He was one of Celestine's original tuxedo drummers. He was a fine little drummer. He was the one who gave me my inspiration. I used to go watch him. I used to go to a club that used to call the Black Gold in a club that called Chiney Town where he would play on 7 and La Salle at the time. He was my inspiration. I used to watch him. He was a wonderful drummer. He could play. He was little and he sat behind those big drums and having those big 28-inch bass drum. He said you…
How big was your bass drum when you started at Ludwig that you got the long drum? That was 28-inch. 28-inch.
